lineage: Designed after the typed-mixing v1 development diagnostic failed H2 because both directions collapsed. V2 is not a parameter retuning of v1: it tests the leaf-location direction appearing in Theorem 4, using a finite Bernoulli tree and binary leaf marks so canonical Fisher information is exactly enumerable.
decision: Whether the fixed-depth recursive-mean theorem has a finite, canonical counterpart that retains leaf content substantially better than branching intensity through depths 2, 3, and 4.

hypotheses.H1: The exact finite-Bernoulli oracle score-sum and degree-aware score recursions have both generalized Fisher eigenvalues within 1e-10 of one at every tested depth.
hypotheses.H2: For the headline quantized recursive-mean channel, canonical leaf-location efficiency minus canonical intensity efficiency exceeds 0.10 at every depth r=2,3,4.
hypotheses.H3: The sign of the H2 gap is positive at both quantizer-resolution controls for every depth r=2,3,4.

model.offspring: Each internal vertex has 16 candidate children, each present independently with q(lambda)=lambda/16.
model.leaf_marks: At depth zero, X is in {-1,+1} with P_theta(X=x)=(1+x*theta)/2.

quantized_recursive_mean.update: h_v^r=Q_delta(mean_{u present child of v} h_u^{r-1}), with empty mean equal to zero
quantized_recursive_mean.rounding: nearest grid point with deterministic ties-to-even

channels.score_sum: Exact finite-Bernoulli complete-score recursion at the fiducial environment.
channels.score_mean_plus_degree: Algebraically identical reconstruction using total present degree and the mean of per-present-child score messages.

estimand.primary: Canonical representation Fisher information F_H=Var(E[S_complete|H]); no decoder class, nuisance regression, or empirical Fisher.
estimand.normalization: Generalized eigenvalues of (F_H,F_O) and the physical lambda/theta directional efficiencies.

method.probability_recursion: Propagate the finite hidden-state probabilities and their lambda/theta derivatives by exact convolution over all 16 Bernoulli candidates, then push through the frozen quantized mean.
method.score_identity: The propagated derivative grad p(h) equals E[S_complete*1{H=h}], yielding canonical F_H directly.
method.tail_approximation: None; both branching and hidden alphabets are finite.
method.precision: IEEE float64 plus a full 80-digit Decimal recomputation.
method.independent_checks: Finite differences of the probability-only recursion, a tiny exhaustive-tree enumeration, independently coded complete-score second moments, eigendirection residuals, PSD contraction, and exact reciprocal-grid validation.

scientific_success: validity AND H1 AND H2 AND H3

falsification.H1: Either oracle score channel is farther than 1e-10 from unit generalized efficiency.
falsification.H2: At any headline depth 2,3,4, leaf-location efficiency minus intensity efficiency is <=0.10.
falsification.H3: Either resolution control has a nonpositive leaf-location-minus-intensity gap at any depth 2,3,4.

reporting.main_candidate: Only the canonical depthwise intensity-versus-leaf-location separation if the full conjunction passes independent audit.
reporting.appendix_candidate: Full matrices, generalized directions, resolution controls, and numerical certificates.
reporting.omit_from_manuscript: The failed v1 typed-mixing diagnostic and all auxiliary outputs, except in artifact chronology if needed.
reporting.governance: The current manuscript remains immutable. A passed, publicly timestamped, independently audited v2 result creates a new manuscript fork; otherwise no manuscript change.
